RESOLUTION.DESC:
The Security Council,
Thankful that [region]Portugal de Esquerda[/region] was successfully freed from the grasp of invaders that sought to close its borders permanently and claim it as their trophy,
Noting that the former occupiers no longer pose a risk to the region and have long been evicted from it,
Acknowledging that, despite the continuous use of the region as a battlefield by other invader groups, defenders and other miscellaneous military operators, native control has been reestablished and there have been no attempts at permanently occupying the region in recent times,
Recognizing that, in the absence of a governor, the currently in place resolution acts as a detriment for the permanent security of the region and its sovereignty,
Hereby repeals [url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=WA_past_resolution/id=470/council=2]Liberate Portugal de Esquerda[/url].
RESOLUTION.NAME: Repeal "Liberate Portugal de Esquerda"
